content: In the closed-form LASSO solution f_LASSO(x) = (1 - lambda)_+ x_1 + sum_{i=2}^{d+1} (eta - lambda)_+ x_i, the coordinate x_1 is the special feature and x_2, ..., x_{d+1} are the abundant weak common features; with 0 < eta << 1, choosing lambda approximately eta makes every common-feature coefficient (eta - lambda)_+ zero while leaving the special-feature coefficient (1 - lambda)_+ positive.
